body.name: \(\mathcal B_{m,n}\)
body.construction: Simulate \(Z^{\ast}_{m,n}\mid\mathrm{data}\sim N(0,\widehat R_{m,n})\), take \(\widehat c_{m,n}(1-\alpha)=\inf\{c:\Pr(\max_{\ell\le H_n}|Z^{\ast}_{m,n,\ell}|\le c\mid\mathrm{data})\ge1-\alpha\}\), and form \(\mathcal B_{m,n}=\prod_{\ell=1}^{H_n}[\widehat\theta_{m,n,\ell}\pm\widehat c_{m,n}(1-\alpha)\widehat s_{m,n,\ell}]\), with a deterministic measurable fallback on spectral or variance failure.
